BLESSED_FRUIT

A Blessed Fruit is a RARE Reforge Stone that applies the Blessed Reforge to a Farming Tool. It grants  Farming Fortune,  Speed and ☯ Farming Wisdom.

Contents

  • 1 Obtaining
  • 2 Usage
    • 2.1 Reforging
  • 3 Tips
  • 4 Trivia
  • 5 History
  • 6 Navigation

Obtaining

[edit | edit source]

A Blessed Fruit can purchased from the Smithmonger for 1,000,000 Coins.

Usage

[edit | edit source]

Reforging

[edit | edit source]

Blessed Fruit can be combined with a Farming Tool using an Anvil or The Hex to apply the Blessed reforge, to grant  Farming Fortune,  Speed and ☯ Farming Wisdom, which scale with the Farming Tool's rarity. This has a skill requirement of  Mining XXV (25). A Farming Tool that is already reforged to Blessed will grant the stats, even if the player doesn't meet the requirement to apply it.

Additionally, it grants the Blessed Bonus, which grants 0.25% (1 in 400) chance to find enchanted forms of items when harvesting crops.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • The  Speed bonus used to be applied for each unique hoe in the inventory.
  • Before the addition of ☯ Farming Wisdom, the farming exp bonus from the blessed reforge was additive with the  Rabbit Pet's Farming Exp Boost perk and Derpy's MOAR SKILLZ!!! perk unlike other skill bonuses. [1]
  • When the Blessed bonus activates, the following message is sent in chat:
BLESSED! You found an <enchanted item>!
